sumInsured: Not specified in extract (policy schedule will show chosen Sum Insured; illustrations show examples like ₹5,00,000)

great.name: Room Rent
great.quote: The eligible Room Rent or Room Category applicable for the Insured Person under the Policy is 'No limit', which means that there is no separate restriction on Room Charges incurred towards stay during Hospitalization
great.explanation: Room rent is on a 'No limit' basis during hospitalization. This lets you choose any room category without a room-rent cap driving extra out-of-pocket costs.

great.name: ICU Charges
great.quote: Intensive Care Unit Charges (ICU Charges): The eligible ICU Charges applicable for the Insured Person under the Policy is 'No limit'
great.explanation: ICU charges are covered with 'No limit' as a separate cap. This reduces the chance of large ICU-related expenses being disallowed due to sub-limits.

great.name: Restore Benefit
great.quote: automatically make the re-instatement of up to the base Sum Insured unlimited times in a policy year... Recharge amount can be utilized for same illness as well as different Illnesses.
great.explanation: The base Sum Insured can be reinstated unlimited times in a policy year, and it can be used for the same illness as well as different illnesses. This can significantly increase available coverage if you have multiple or recurring hospitalizations in a year.

great.name: No Claim Bonus
great.quote: In the event of a Claim there is no impact on the accrual of Cumulative Bonus.
great.explanation: Cumulative Bonus continues to accrue even if you make a claim. This is valuable because your bonus-based increase is not reduced or reset due to claims.

great.name: Modern Treatments
great.quote: Advance Technology Methods: The Company will indemnify the Insured Person up to the Sum Insured... for treatment taken through following advance technology methods: ... Robotic surgeries ... Stereotactic radio surgeries ... Bronchical Thermoplasty ...
great.explanation: Advanced technology methods (including robotic surgeries and stereotactic radio surgeries) are covered up to the Sum Insured. This improves access to newer procedures without needing a separate add-on.

good.name: No Claim Bonus
good.quote: enhance the Sum Insured by 50% flat, on a cumulative basis, as a Cumulative Bonus for each completed and continuous Policy Year
good.explanation: Sum Insured is enhanced by 50% for each completed continuous policy year as a Cumulative Bonus. This increases your available cover over time if you maintain the policy.

good.name: PED Waiting Period
good.quote: excluded until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy with insurer.
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are not covered for the first 36 months of continuous coverage. Claims related to declared/undeclared PEDs can be rejected until this waiting period is completed.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting Period
good.quote: excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage
good.explanation: Listed specific illnesses are not covered for the first 24 months of continuous coverage. This delays coverage for those conditions even if they are not pre-existing.

good.name: Initial Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident
good.explanation: Illness-related treatment is excluded for the first 30 days from the first policy commencement date, except for accidents. This means early non-accident claims can be denied during the first month.

good.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: For a period of 60 days immediately prior to the Insured Person's date of admission to the Hospital
good.explanation: Pre-hospitalization medical expenses are covered for 60 days before admission. This helps pay for consultations, tests, and medicines leading up to hospitalization.

good.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: For a period of 180 days immediately after the Insured Person's date of discharge from the hospital
good.explanation: Post-hospitalization medical expenses are covered for 180 days after discharge. This supports follow-up treatment and medicines during recovery.

good.name: Domiciliary Hospitalization
good.quote: The Company will indemnify the Insured Person... for the Medical Expenses incurred towards Domiciliary Hospitalization
good.explanation: Medical expenses for domiciliary hospitalization (treatment at home when hospitalization is required) are covered as per policy conditions. This can help when a hospital bed is unavailable or the patient cannot be moved.

bad.name: Consumables
bad.quote: Any item or condition or treatment specified in List of Non-Medical Items (Annexure – I to Policy Terms & Conditions).
bad.explanation: Items listed as non-medical/consumables in Annexure I are excluded from cover. This can increase your out-of-pocket costs for common hospital items during a claim.

bad.name: Restore Benefit
bad.quote: The Recharge shall be utilized only after the base Sum Insured, applicable Cumulative Bonus , Cumulative Bonus Super (if applicable) and Plus Benefit (if applicable) have been completely exhausted in that Policy Year.
bad.explanation: Recharge can be used only after the base Sum Insured and all applicable bonuses/benefits are completely exhausted in that policy year. This makes the restore a last-layer protection rather than something that helps early in a large claim.

bad.name: Co-pay (Optional)
bad.quote: The Co-payment proportion ( If opted ) shall be borne by the Insured Person on each Claim...
bad.reference: General Conditions Applicable To All The Benefits And Optional Benefits, point 4; and Optional Benefit 3.2.7
bad.explanation: An optional co-payment applies if opted, meaning you bear a proportion of each claim. Any co-pay increases your out-of-pocket share on every claim where it is selected.
